[infowski]
infowski 10/15/2021 5:56 PM
Also - "elevated" service = running with elevated privileges
(basically - as root) - this is what that script is responsible for:
https://github.com/webosbrew/webos-homebrew-channel/blob/main/services/elevate-service -
but that of course requires root privileges to poke around system
configuration files. It's launched by stage3 of rootmytv exploit right
after installing Homebrew Channel app. (and then by homebrew channel
service itself during its updates, since the service is not killed when
its underlying app is upgraded... :))
10/15/2021 5:52 PM
If it says pending, then the service didn't start up for some reason. If
it says it's unelevated then that's somewhat of an expected behaviour on
non-rooted device. If the service is running but the getAppInfo call is
failing, you should've gotten a message when opening app details view...
